name: Remote System Discovery
description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of other systems by IP address, hostname, or other logical identifier on a network that may be used for lateral movement. Functionality could exist within remote access tools or built-in utilities like ping, net view, arp, and nltest to enable this.
detection: Monitor for process and command-line execution of discovery utilities such as ping, net, arp, and nltest. Correlate host enumeration commands with subsequent connection attempts to newly discovered systems.
mitigations: M1042: Disable or Remove Feature or Program — restrict discovery utilities where feasible
